chunks: Not one habitation that We destroyed before them had believed. So how can they believe?
ai.seo_question: Which cities or communities were destroyed before their people believed?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (21:11) highlights the pattern of divine retribution against communities that rejected their prophets despite clear signs, serving as a warning to the Quraysh. It underscores the concept of 'tadabbur' (reflection), urging believers to analyze historical precedents to understand the consequences of spiritual arrogance and the necessity of sincere faith before it is too late.
